subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 1: Welcome back (story and freetime activities)
outcomes: I can name the Discovery Team and tell the main events of the story.
I can ask and answer about weekly activities: On Sundays, Sami plays football.
I can say what a person is doing now: She's building a robot.

tf.s: In the story, there is a new girl at the school.
tf.why: Yes! A new girl comes to the school in the story.

tf.s: The new girl at the school is from Oman.
On Mondays, Sami goes to Chess Club.
tf.why: Right! The week planner shows Chess Club for Sami on Mondays.

tf.s: On Tuesdays, Fatma and Lottie have a tennis lesson.
tf.why: On Tuesdays, they have a swimming lesson.

tf.s: We say "On Mondays" for something we do every Monday.
tf.why: Yes! On + days tells us about our weekly routine.

tf.s: "He's play football now." is a correct sentence.
tf.why: We need -ing: He's playing football now.

tf.s: Bo says the children are very busy.
tf.why: Yes! Bo says: You are all very busy!

tf.s: Bo is a member of the Discovery Team.
tf.why: Great! Sami, Fatma, Lottie and Bo are the Discovery Team.

tf.s: "She's building a robot" tells us what she does every week.
tf.why: It tells us what she is doing now.

tf.s: We say "In Fridays, I visit Granny."
tf.why: We use on with days: On Fridays, I visit Granny.

boxes.q: Where is the new girl from?
boxes.why: The story says she's from Egypt.

boxes.q: What does Sami do on Sundays?
Who says "You are all very busy!"?
boxes.why: Bo says it because the children have activities on most days.
For now, we use is + playing.
On + days + present simple for a routine.

boxes.q: Which one is a club in the week planner?
boxes.why: Basketball Club and Chess Club are clubs.
What is she doing? asks about now.

boxes.q: Sami ___ to Chess Club on Mondays.
boxes.why: Sami goes: he, she or a name takes -s.

boxes.q: Which word is a day of the week?
boxes.why: Thursday is a day of the week.
A music lesson is something we do in our free time.

hunt.q: Sami, Fatma, Lottie and Bo: the ___ Team

mcq.why: The four members are Sami, Fatma, Lottie and Bo.

mcq.q: What does Sami do on Mondays?
mcq.why: The week planner shows Chess Club on Mondays.

mcq.q: "She's building a robot." This sentence is in the ___.
mcq.why: be + verb-ing is the present continuous.

mcq.q: Which words do we use for an activity every Wednesday?
mcq.why: We use On + days for weekly activities.

mcq.q: A picture shows a boy kicking a ball right now. Which sentence fits?
mcq.why: For an action now, use is + verb-ing.

mcq.q: Which sentence about your Fridays is correct?
o: On Fridays, I visit my grandparents.
On Fridays, I visiting my grandparents.
On Fridays, I am visit my grandparents.
On Fridays, I visits my grandparents.
mcq.why: For a routine, use the present simple: I visit.

mcq.q: The planner says: Tuesdays – Fatma and Lottie – swimming lesson. Which sentence is correct?
o: On Tuesdays, Fatma and Lottie have a swimming lesson.
On Tuesdays, Fatma and Lottie has a swimming lesson.
In Tuesdays, Fatma and Lottie have a swimming lesson.
On Tuesdays, Fatma and Lottie having a swimming lesson.
mcq.why: Two people take have, and days take on.

mcq.q: Why does Bo say "You are all very busy!"?
o: The children have activities on most days.
mcq.why: They have clubs, lessons and visits on most days, so they are busy.

mcq.q: Which sentence tells us about a routine, not about now?
mcq.why: On Sundays + present simple shows a routine.

mcq.q: "Lottie is swimming." When is this happening?
mcq.why: The present continuous tells us what is happening now.
